_doc: Special Delivery: carry an unmarked package while agents chase you. Wanted level (stars) rises while you are seen; at each star more agents join (levels[star-1]) and from helicopterAt stars a helicopter sweeps a searchlight. Stay unseen for evadeSeconds (+evadePerStar per star) to lose them, then they search the last place they saw you for searchSeconds. You can only make the drop when nobody is chasing you. For alertSeconds at the start (and part of it when reinforcements arrive) the agents know where you are. Stopped (under bustSpeed m/s) with an agent within bustRadius m fills the bust meter; full = busted. Pay = pay + pay × wantedBonus × highest star reached.

contracts.name: Unmarked Crate
contracts.brief: No questions, no paperwork. Two agents at most – lose them in the trees.

contracts.name: Night Courier
contracts.brief: Across the valley after dark. Stay long enough and the helicopter comes up.

contracts.name: Hot Cargo
contracts.brief: They already know what you're carrying. Up to the ridge with company.

contracts.name: The Big One
contracts.brief: Coast to coast with the whole task force behind you. The biggest payday in Frostpine.
